oracle: The existing selected-data fixture supplies fixed expected values and typed successor inputs. Compiler, collectors, evaluator, reply identity checks and LocalVm are unchanged. declaration_order_oracle: Two unused integer parameters respectively cause recoverable arithmetic failure and nonrecoverable loop-limit failure. Declaration order determines whether outer recovery completes or the pipeline fails before its successor, irrespective of written argument order. An unselected call evaluates neither argument. This tests observable behaviour without a second evaluator or private binding-order inspection.
ceiling_scope: The test fixture now takes MAX_FUNCTIONS and MAX_FUNCTION_PARAMETERS from the native syntax facade instead of capping declarations at eight. Production ceilings remain 32 and eight. Full-ceiling programs contain unused arithmetic-faulting helpers; compilation checks them but execution does not evaluate them.
fuel_scope: Every mixed-signature path compares observed cost minus one, exact cost and cost plus one, with zero and one remaining on successful boundaries. This is not every smaller fuel budget.

Case counts are iterations within four Rust tests, not independent test functions. Overlapping commands must not be summed as unique tests. No Linux, remote CI, live GUI or complete extraction claim.
remaining_boundaries: Complete declared-language acceptance beyond scalar, control and declaration slices.
Host-neutral durable recovery ownership and full checkpoint acceptance.
Final independent repository and distribution acceptance.
